P1.measure: dev-5 first-turn hypotheses with a checker v2 claim match confirmed by a person (Y)
P1.rule: dev-5 first-turn hypotheses that blame citations, labels or evidence ids. A person marks every delivered dev-5 row Y or N in review-blinded.csv without seeing the checker or the arm. Confirmed = a checker v2 claim match AND the person's Y. Pass if CONTROL confirmed >= 20 of 40 AND GUIDE confirmed plus GUIDE rows the person marked Y without a checker match (these are counted against the GUIDE bar) <= 4 of 40; CONTROL confirmed < 20 of 40 is UNINFORMATIVE (the premise failed).

P2.measure: dev-5 first-attempt validity and over-600 counts

P3.measure: secondary, counts and one-sided Fisher tests, no pass bar; person columns need the review file

P4.measure: repair turns returning a valid answer with hypothesis <= 600 characters
P4.worse_means: the Rule 1 message's valid-within-600 total over both setups is lower than today's total

decision_rule: Rule 1 ships after its offline tests unless P4 shows the new message is worse than today's. Rule 2 ships only if P1 and P2 pass. If P1 fails, the next design trims the label text from diagnosis requests only. If P1 passes but P3 shows declines unchanged, the Mechanic's veto persists and the gate question goes to the owner separately.

repeats.note: A request key whose delivered answers are all identical is one sample repeated, not ten independent samples; read the P1-P4 counts with the distinct counts beside them.
